content: Context brief — /review of the RepoCademy gate plumbing (SPEC-20260715-062207, ADR-0029): scripts/education/{gate_registry,ingest_walkthrough_session}.py + docs/education/{gates.yaml,CONTRACTS.md} + tests. Risk medium (new untrusted-input boundary that can flip Principle #6 gates). Panel: security-specialist + independent-perspective (both non-participating; qa + architecture covered at build checkpoints in DISC-20260715-062334).

Verdict approve-with-changes (conf 0.82). BLOCKING: untrusted free text (deferral reason, feedback, narration) written unsanitized into gates.yaml/events.jsonl then printed raw by gate_registry list — terminal-injection foothold via ANSI/control chars in crafted transcripts; fix = strip control chars + ANSI CSI/OSC from all free-text fields before write. ADVISORY: 2000x50k=100MB DoS shape (add total-payload cap ~2MB); chapter.number int() coercion crashes with raw traceback on non-numeric (validate instead); slug/path traversal VERIFIED SAFE; yaml.safe_load/dump + mkstemp/os.replace + parameterized SQL + enum whitelists all sound.

Verdict approve-with-changes (conf 0.82). BLOCKING (documentation): gate outcome computed entirely from CLIENT-ASSERTED grades AND a client-supplied pass_threshold bounded only by (0,1] — self-certification unless the human evidence-PR merge is named as the load-bearing certification, which no shipped file states; fix = trust-model paragraph in CONTRACTS/docstring/ADR + floor pass_threshold >=0.5. ADVISORY-high: all-or-nothing claim overstated — per-row commits mid-loop mean a crash strands rows behind the idempotency key with the gate un-flipped and re-ingest blocked; make DB phase one transaction + document recovery. ADVISORY-low: quiz_summary.average decorative/unvalidated — cross-check vs recomputed. Consistency across CONTRACTS/ADR/SPEC/code verified tight; seeded gates archaeology verified honest (REV-20260610-012629, REV-20260611-200830, WALKTHROUGH-20260627 all exist).

ALL FINDINGS FOLDED IN-SESSION: (1) _sanitize_text + sanitize_transcript strip ANSI CSI/OSC + control chars from every free-text field before any write (regression test with raw escape sequences asserts events.jsonl + gates.yaml clean); (2) MAX_TOTAL_TEXT=2MB cap; (3) chapter.number validated as int (shell-string type-confusion test); (4) MIN_PASS_THRESHOLD=0.5 floor (test: 0.01 rejected); (5) trust-model paragraph added to module docstring + CONTRACTS R5 + ADR-0029 Decision 4 — human evidence-PR merge named as the load-bearing certification, ingest = registration; (6) education_results writes batched into ONE SQLite transaction, docstring documents the crash-recovery path (gate_registry clear); (7) quiz_summary.average cross-checked vs recomputed grades (+-0.01, test). Suite now 68 tests, 93% coverage on scripts/education. VERDICT: APPROVE post-fold.

REVIEW COMPLETE — approve-with-changes -> APPROVE post-fold (~0.85 weighted). 2 BLOCKING folded (terminal-injection sanitization; self-certification trust-model documentation + threshold floor), 4 ADVISORY folded (total-text cap, chapter.number validation, single-transaction DB phase + recovery doc, average cross-check), 0 deferred. Report: docs/reviews/REV-20260715-064028.md. Checkpoint history: arch APPROVE + qa REVISE->APPROVE (DISC-20260715-062334).
